name: Captain America
summary: A frontline disruptor who blocks burst damage and creates openings for duelists.

abilities.name: Shield Bash
abilities.description: Charge forward and stun the first enemy hit.

abilities.name: Liberty Throw
abilities.description: Throw shield to damage and briefly reveal marked enemies.

abilities.name: Freedom Aegis
abilities.description: Project a large kinetic barrier that absorbs heavy incoming fire.

combos.name: Engage Pick Combo
steps: Call duelist follow-up while target is locked.
combos.teamUp: Works best with burst duelists that can secure stunned targets.

synergies.reason: Sustained support lets Captain hold space longer.

playstyle.overview: Anchor your team in chokepoints and deny entry angles.
playstyle.positioning: Hold off-angles near cover to rotate your shield efficiently.

name: Scarlet Witch
summary: A high-pressure skirmisher that excels at isolated target deletion and tempo control.

resource.name: Chaos Meter
resource.description: Build chaos through hits to amplify burst windows.

abilities.name: Hex Bolt
abilities.description: Rapid magic bolts with strong close-mid pressure.

abilities.name: Warp Seal
abilities.description: Short-range blink that resets line-of-sight.

abilities.name: Chaos Collapse
abilities.description: Creates a vortex that drags enemies before detonating.

combos.name: Blink Burst
steps: Tag target from off-angle with Hex Bolt.
Blink past cover to force crosshair flick.
Commit burst during chaos meter spike.

synergies.reason: Control tools keep enemies in Scarlet's burst range.

playstyle.overview: Play hit-and-run until cooldowns are baited, then all-in quickly.
playstyle.positioning: Abuse vertical and diagonal entry angles to avoid predictable peeks.

name: Rocket Raccoon
summary: A flexible support strategist with strong utility and consistent sustain output.

abilities.name: Repair Burst
abilities.description: Deploy a short AoE heal with over-heal on full targets.

abilities.name: Scrap Mine
abilities.description: Trap that slows and reveals enemies that pass through.

abilities.name: Orbital Salvage
abilities.description: Summons a support drone swarm that heals allies and damages enemies.

combos.name: Peel Loop
steps: Drop Scrap Mine between diver and your backline.
Trigger Repair Burst as ally takes first burst.
Call frontline turn once diver cooldowns are spent.

synergies.reason: Sustain plus frontline shielding creates high objective uptime.

playstyle.overview: Control access points and keep your carries active with pre-emptive healing.
playstyle.positioning: Stay one lane behind your frontline and rotate around safe cover.

name: Hulk
summary: A transformation-based frontliner that cycles between setup, brawl pressure, and empowered crowd control.

resource.name: Gamma Rage
resource.description: Build rage in combat to access stronger transformation windows.

abilities.name: Gamma Slam
abilities.description: Leap and crash down to displace enemies in a small area.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Release a short-range shockwave that pushes enemies back.

abilities.name: Hulk Out
abilities.description: Trigger empowered transformation and replace core abilities.

forms.name: Bruce Banner
forms.summary: A setup-focused form that pokes safely and prepares transformation timing.

abilities.name: Gamma Pistol
abilities.description: Sustained ranged poke that builds Gamma Rage.

abilities.name: Gamma Barrier
abilities.description: Deploy a short-duration barrier to survive dives.

abilities.name: Mutate
abilities.description: Transform into Hero Hulk when Gamma Rage is full.

forms.name: Hero Hulk
forms.summary: Primary frontline form with high space control and dive interruption.

abilities.name: Gamma Slam
abilities.description: Leap and crash down to displace enemies in a small area.

abilities.name: Thunderclap
abilities.description: Release a short-range shockwave that pushes enemies back.

abilities.name: Gamma Guard
abilities.description: Reduce incoming damage while charging a counter shockwave.

forms.name: Monster Hulk
forms.summary: Short empowered form with stronger crowd control and burst finish potential.

abilities.name: Worldbreaker Slam
abilities.description: Heavy leap slam with a larger knock-up radius.

abilities.name: Seismic Clap
abilities.description: Empowered clap that chains damage in a cone.

abilities.name: Unstoppable Rage
abilities.description: Gain movement speed and unstoppable status during engage.

combos.name: Mutate Frontline Engage
steps: Build Gamma Rage while poking in Banner form.
Mutate into Hero Hulk at objective entry timing.
Open with Gamma Slam, then clap to force cooldowns.
combos.teamUp: Pair with follow-up burst to convert displacement into picks.

synergies.reason: Sustain and utility increase Hulk's frontline uptime during transform windows.

playstyle.overview: Cycle forms around objective timings and avoid wasting empowered windows on low-value targets.
playstyle.positioning: Use Banner form from safe angles, then take aggressive space once transformed.
